name: Interaction Atlas
author: István Koren
description: Object-centric visual analytics for when and how objects co-occur over their lifecycles. An upper-triangular atlas opens into a lifecycle-interaction tomogram with exact rectangular or lasso-bin selection, inversion, side-by-side remainder comparison, and source-bound lasso cohorts consumable by compatible views.

objectTypes.title: Object types
objectTypes.description: Empty means every object type. This filter defines the visible atlas and analysis population.

optionsFrom.sql: SELECT object_type AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM {object} WHERE object_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, object_type

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: Empty means all activities. The filter is applied to interaction events.

optionsFrom.sql: SELECT activity AS value, COUNT(*) AS n FROM {event} WHERE activity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, activity

timeStart.title: Time range
timeStart.description: Limits interaction events by calendar time.

lifecycleBounds.title: Lifecycle bounds
lifecycleBounds.description: Fixed uses complete source lifecycles and filters only interaction observations. Recomputed derives bounds from the filtered event population.

weighting.title: Interaction mass
weighting.description: Equal event mass: each event contributes total mass one per object-type pair. Object-pair mass: every co-occurring object pair contributes equally, so large batches contribute multiple observations.

binCount.title: Bin resolution
binCount.description: The deterministic lifecycle-phase grid. Phase 1.0 belongs to the final bin.

displayScale.title: Display scale
displayScale.description: Visual-only scaling; it never changes the underlying interaction mass.

pairOrder.title: Atlas ordering
pairOrder.description: Similarity places object types with comparable interaction profiles next to one another; ties are deterministic.

optionsFrom.sql: SELECT 'one-to-one' AS value, 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 'one-to-many', 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'many-to-one', 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'many-to-many', 4

includeZeroDurationObjects.title: Include zero-duration lifecycles
includeZeroDurationObjects.description: When enabled, objects with one distinct timestamp contribute at phase 0.5.

rippleWindowHours.title: Follow-ripple window
rippleWindowHours.description: Temporal context around selected contact objects. It counts same-object neighboring events before/after the anchors; it is descriptive and never causal.
